ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a three-phase voltage source inverter, with the left DC power supply labeled 600 V; the inverter has three-phase output terminals, and the load on the right is three resistors in star connection, each phase labeled 20 Ω, with the star point not connected to the DC side or the inverter neutral point. Reasoning: According to the 120° device conduction mode, in each conduction interval only two-phase loads are connected to the DC bus, equivalent to two 20 Ω phase resistors in series connected across the two terminals of the 600 V DC source. Therefore the equivalent resistance is 20+20=40 Ω, and the current I=600/40=15 A. At this time, the total power of the two conducting resistors is I^2R=15^2×40=9000 W=9 kW. The equivalent situation is the same in each conduction interval, so the average load power is 9 kW.

raw_record.question_text: A 3-phase voltage source inverter is supplied from a 600 V DC source as shown in the figure below. For a star-connected resistive load of 20 Ω per phase, the load power for 120° device conduction, in kW is ______.

method.method_draft: From the image, identify the star load as three 20 Ω resistors connected to the inverter output terminals, with an isolated neutral. From the text, take Vdc = 600 V and conduction mode = 120°. In any conduction interval, reduce the active load path to two 20 Ω phase resistors in series across 600 V. Compute current I = 600/(20+20) = 15 A, then total power in the two conducting resistors is I^2(40) = 9000 W = 9 kW. Since every interval has the same two-resistor path, the average load power is 9 kW.

method.method_draft: First note from the image that all three load phases are equal 20 Ω resistors in a floating star. From the text, use Vdc = 600 V and 120° conduction. During each nonzero phase-current pulse, two equal phase resistors share the DC bus, so the phase current magnitude is 15 A. For any one phase, the current waveform is +15 A for 120°, 0 for 120°, and -15 A for 120°, so I_phase,rms = 15√(240/360) = 15√(2/3). Then per-phase power is I_rms^2 R = 15^2×(2/3)×20 = 3000 W, and three phases give 9000 W = 9 kW.

图像描述：图中是一个三相电压源逆变器，左侧直流母线标注为 600 V；逆变器有三组桥臂，每组桥臂输出一个相端。右侧负载画成星形连接，三个支路均标注为 20 Ω，星点没有接到直流母线或其他外部中性线，因此是浮置星形负载。

推理：按 120° 器件导通方式，在任一非零导通区间，只有两相负载接入直流母线回路。由于两相电阻相等，等效为两个 20 Ω 电阻串联跨接在 600 V 直流电源上，所以相电流幅值为 I = 600 / (20 + 20) = 15 A。对任一相而言，电流波形为 +15 A 持续 120°、0 持续 120°、-15 A 持续 120°。因此该相 RMS 电流为 I_rms = 15 × sqrt((120 + 120)/360) = 15 × sqrt(2/3) A。每相平均功率为 P_phase = I_rms^2 R = 15^2 × (2/3) × 20 = 3000 W。三相总负载功率为 P_total = 3 × 3000 = 9000 W = 9 kW。
